lessons.title: Legislature passes NHI senior subsidies
lessons.title_zh: 立法院通過長者健保補助法案

paragraphs.en: The Legislative Yuan has passed an amendment to the Senior Citizens Welfare Act that requires the central government to fully pay National Health Insurance (NHI) premiums for eligible older citizens. Proposed by lawmakers from the Chinese Nationalist Party (KMT) and the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP), the bill was approved with a vote of 60 to 39. Under this new rule, residents aged 65 and above qualify if their annual net consolidated income is subject to an income tax rate of under 20 percent, which currently means NT$1.38 million or less.
paragraphs.zh: 立法院通過了《老人福利法》修正案，要求中央政府為符合資格的長者全額補助全民健康保險（NHI）保費。該法案由中國國民黨（KMT）和台灣民眾黨（TPP）立委提出，以60票對39票表決通過。在這項新規定下，年滿65歲且全年綜合所得淨額適用所得稅率低於20%（目前意味著新台幣138萬元或以下）的居民即具備補助資格。

paragraphs.en: The TPP caucus stated that this policy delivers on a campaign promise made by its founder, Ko Wen-je, during his 2024 presidential bid. While serving as the mayor of Taipei, Ko previously created similar subsidies for older residents. Although several other local cities and counties later copied the measure, poorer local governments struggled to pay for it. The TPP calculated that the nationwide plan will cost the central government nearly NT$39 billion each year, based on a monthly subsidy of NT$826 per person.
paragraphs.zh: 民眾黨黨團表示，這項政策落實了該黨創黨主席柯文哲在2024年總統大選期間所提出的競選承諾。柯文哲在擔任台北市長期間，曾為年長市民推行過類似的補助方案。儘管其他幾個地方縣市隨後也採納了相同做法，但財政較吃緊的地方政府卻無力負擔。民眾黨估計，以每位長者每月補助新台幣826元計算，這項全國性計畫每年將耗費中央政府近390億元。

paragraphs.en: However, Minister of Health and Welfare Shih Chung-liang voiced strong worries about the legal change. He warned that it breaks the system's core principle, where citizens contribute according to their financial ability. Shih noted that elections pass quickly, but the health system "needs to be stable and sustainable." Because Taiwan is already a super-aged society where seniors make up one-fifth of the total population and consume over 42 percent of NHI spending, he argued that this additional fiscal burden could harm long-term operations and cause intergenerational unfairness.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，衛生福利部部長石崇良對該項修法表達了強烈擔憂。他警告這違背了該體系依民眾財務能力繳納保費的核心原則。石崇良指出，選舉很快就會過去，但健保制度「需要穩定且具永續性」。由於台灣已邁入超高齡社會，65歲以上長者占總人口五分之一，且耗用了超過42%的健保支出，他認為這項額外的財政負擔可能會損害長期運作，並造成世代不公。

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers from the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) also raised objections. DPP caucus secretary-general Fan Yun questioned where the money would come from and who would ultimately bear the financial load. Meanwhile, DPP caucus chief executive Chuang Jui-hsiung criticized the opposition for sending the proposal directly to a second reading without standard committee reviews. He stressed that any bill requiring major public spending must clearly explain how costs should be shared between central and local authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 民主進步黨（DPP）立委也提出了反對意見。民進黨黨團幹事長范雲質疑這筆資金要從哪裡來，以及最終該由誰來承擔這筆財務負擔。與此同時，民進黨黨團書記長莊瑞雄批評在野黨跳過正常的委員會審查，直接將提案送交二讀。他強調，任何涉及重大公共支出的法案都必須清楚說明中央與地方政府之間該如何分攤成本。

lessons.title: Economic growth to be highest in 39 years: CIER
lessons.title_zh: 中經院：經濟成長率將創39年新高

paragraphs.en: Taiwan’s economy is expected to experience its fastest growth in 39 years this year, according to the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research (CIER). The research institute recently raised its annual economic growth forecast to 12.16 percent, which is an increase of 1.81 percentage points from its projection of 10.35 percent in July. CIER president Lien Hsien-ming stated that both domestic and overseas demand have performed remarkably well.
paragraphs.zh: 根據中華經濟研究院（CIER）的資料，臺灣今年的經濟成長預計將創下39年來最快的增速。該研究機構最近將全年的經濟成長預測上調至12.16%，與7月份預估的10.35%相比，增加了1.81個百分點。中經院院長連賢明表示，國內與海外需求表現皆非常出色。

paragraphs.en: CIER projected that domestic demand will contribute 55 percent to the overall annual growth, while net foreign demand will account for the remaining 45 percent. A significant portion of this economic momentum comes from high demand for artificial intelligence (AI) technology. This global trend has supported powerful export growth, while also encouraging stronger business investment and consumer activity at home.
paragraphs.zh: 中經院預估，國內需求將占全年總體成長的55%，而淨海外需求則占其餘的45%。這波經濟動能有很大一部分來自對人工智慧（AI）技術的龐大需求。這股全球趨勢支撐了強勁的出口成長，同時也帶動了國內更堅實的企業投資與消費活動。

paragraphs.en: The upgrade in the forecast was mainly driven by domestic demand exceeding earlier expectations. Major international cloud service providers continue to increase capital spending, leading Taiwanese manufacturers to expand their production capacity. Furthermore, non-technology sectors are investing more money into automation. Consequently, CIER expects private investment to rise by 10.77 percent, and private consumption is likely to expand by 4.94 percent.
paragraphs.zh: 此次預測上修主要是由超越原先預期的國內需求所推動。國際大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大資本支出，促使臺灣製造商擴充產能。此外，非科技產業也投入更多資金於自動化設備。因此，中經院預期民間投資將成長10.77%，而民間消費則可能擴張4.94%。

paragraphs.en: Official figures cited by the think tank showed strong growth of 15.43 percent in the first quarter and 12.93 percent in the second quarter. CIER estimated third-quarter growth at 12.73 percent and fourth-quarter growth at 8.2 percent. In addition, annual inflation is expected to reach 2.06 percent. While the institute raised next year’s growth projection to 5.97 percent, it warned that geopolitical risks, cross-strait ties, and global monetary policy changes could still affect the economy.
paragraphs.zh: 該智庫引用的政府資料顯示，第一季成長率達到強勁的15.43%，第二季則為12.93%。中經院估計第三季成長率為12.73%，第四季為8.2%。此外，全年的通貨膨脹率預計將達到2.06%。儘管該機構將明年的成長預測上調至5.97%，但它警告地緣政治風險、兩岸關係以及全球貨幣政策變化仍可能對經濟造成影響。

lessons.title: Chinese student deported for targeting President Lai
lessons.title_zh: 中國學生因針對賴總統遭驅逐出境

paragraphs.en: The National Immigration Agency (NIA) has cancelled the entry permit of a Chinese exchange student and deported him. The authorities took this firm measure after the student posted threatening statements aimed at President William Lai. The incident occurred shortly after President Lai delivered a speech at National Taiwan University (NTU) during the closing ceremony of the Taiwan Bridge Program.
paragraphs.zh: 內政部移民署（NIA）已廢止一名中國交換學生的入台許可證，並將其驅逐出境。在該名學生發布針對賴清德總統的威脅言論後，主管機關採取了這項堅決的措施。此事件發生於賴總統在台灣大學（NTU）為「台灣橋梁計畫」結業典禮發表演說後不久。

paragraphs.en: The student, whose surname is Wang, uploaded a video of Lai’s speech onto Douyin, the Chinese version of TikTok. In his post, Wang included hostile remarks, such as urging people to "take down little Lai Ching-te." He also posted political slogans against Taiwan independence. The online video quickly sparked strong public anger in Taiwan, leading many citizens to demand his immediate deportation.
paragraphs.zh: 這名王姓學生將賴總統演說的影片上傳至中國版TikTok「抖音」。王生在貼文中包含了敵對言論，例如呼籲眾人「拿下賴兒清德」。他還發布了反對台獨的政治標語。該網路影片迅速在台灣引發強烈的公眾怒火，促使許多民眾要求立即將他驅逐出境。

paragraphs.en: As public concern escalated, Wang issued an apology, insisting that he had no intention of physically hurting anyone. However, the NIA worked with the Mainland Affairs Council and the Ministry of Education to investigate the matter thoroughly. Officials determined that Wang had violated the principle of mutual respect and dignity, creating unnecessary unrest within Taiwanese society.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著大眾關注升溫，王生發表了道歉聲明，堅稱自己並無對任何人造成人身傷害的意圖。然而，移民署與大陸委員會及教育部合作，徹查了這起事件。官員認定王生違反了相互尊重與尊嚴的原則，在台灣社會引發了不必要的動盪。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, Wang was deported and barred from visiting Taiwan for five years. Under relevant government regulations, Chinese visitors who fail to respect local norms can have their permits revoked. Furthermore, the NIA declared that future entry applications from Wang would face strict scrutiny. NTU accompanied the student during official questioning and stated that it respected the government's legal decision. The university also emphasized that exercising the right to free speech should always involve respecting others.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，王生遭到驅逐出境，並被禁止入境台灣五年。根據政府相關法規，未能遵守當地規範的中國訪客可能會被廢止許可證。此外，移民署宣布，王生未來提出的入境申請將面臨嚴格審查。台大在官方訊問期間陪同該名學生，並表示尊重政府的依法處分。該校並強調，行使言論自由權利時應始終包含對他人的尊重。

lessons.title: £800,000 spent on scrapped sports dome project
lessons.title_zh: 已取消的體育巨蛋計畫耗資80萬英鎊

paragraphs.en: Ulster University (UU) in Northern Ireland has revealed that it spent £800,000 on an indoor sports arena before canceling the plan. First unveiled in 2024, the multimillion-pound facility in Londonderry was intended to host various activities, including rugby, football, and Gaelic games. However, the university scrapped the project in August because officials realized it was no longer financially possible to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 北愛爾蘭的阿爾斯特大學（Ulster University，簡稱 UU）透露，該校在取消計畫前，已在一座室內體育場館上花費了80萬英鎊。這座位於倫敦德里（Londonderry）、耗資數百萬英鎊的設施於2024年首次亮相，原先預計容納包含橄欖球、足球和蓋爾式運動在內的多種活動。然而，該大學在8月份取消了該計畫，因為相關主管意識到在財務上已無法繼續推行。

paragraphs.en: Details about the spending emerged after a Freedom of Information request from BBC Radio Foyle. The university explained that roughly £700,000 went toward project-related activities, while another £100,000 was used for governance and management. This disclosure came at a difficult time for UU, which previously announced it had to save around £25m and lay off up to 450 workers.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國廣播公司福伊爾廣播電台（BBC Radio Foyle）提出《資訊自由法》申請後，這筆支出的相關細節隨之曝光。該大學說明，大約有70萬英鎊用於與計畫相關的活動，另外10萬英鎊則用於治理與管理。這項揭露正值 UU 的艱困時期，該校先前已宣布必須節省約2500萬英鎊，並裁員多達450名員工。

paragraphs.en: Estimated building expenses had surged from an original £16.8m to £20.1m by the time leaders abandoned the idea. In addition, operating the 15,000-square-metre venue would have required more than £1m each year. The complex was supposed to receive £9.16m (€10.86m) from PeacePlus, an international programme supported by the European Union, the UK, the Irish government, and Stormont, alongside £8.3m from UU.
paragraphs.zh: 在負責人放棄該構想時，預估的建築費用已從最初的1680萬英鎊飆升至2010萬英鎊。此外，若要營運這座占地1萬5000平方公尺的場館，每年需要花費超過100萬英鎊。該綜合場館原定從由歐盟、英國政府、愛爾蘭政府和斯托蒙特（Stormont）共同支持的國際「PeacePlus」計畫獲得916萬英鎊（1086萬歐元），並由 UU 提供830萬英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Criticism followed the revelation. Sinéad McLaughlin, an SDLP assembly member, questioned why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion. She noted that Northern Ireland's higher education system faced a funding crisis, meaning the university could never maintain the facility. Meanwhile, the university stated that ending the plan was "an inevitable consequence" of the wider financial difficulties in the sector.
paragraphs.zh: 此消息曝光後引發了批評。社會民主工黨（SDLP）議會成員西妮德．麥克勞克林（Sinéad McLaughlin）質疑，為何在得出這樣的結論之前，就耗費了如此多的公帑。她指出北愛爾蘭的高等教育體系正面臨財務危機，意味著該大學絕不可能維持該場館的維護運作。與此同時，該大學表示，停止這項計畫是該領域更廣泛財務困境下的「必然結果」。

paragraphs.en: The Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB) confirmed that no PeacePlus money had been distributed for the building. Officials stated that they are now looking for ways to redirect the remaining funds to other helpful community developments. However, the agency could not promise that the reallocated money would stay in the north-west region.
paragraphs.zh: 特殊歐盟計畫機構（SEUPB）證實，尚未針對該建築發放任何 PeacePlus 資金。官員表示，他們目前正在尋找將剩餘資金重新分配至其他有益社區發展專案的方案。然而，該機構無法承諾重新分配的資金會留在西北部地區。

lessons.title: Healey backs pro-growth case for Heathrow third runway after Burnham ducks issue
lessons.title_zh: 伯納姆迴避議題後 希利支持希斯洛第三跑道促成長論點

paragraphs.en: British Chancellor John Healey has expressed support for building a third runway at Heathrow Airport, arguing that the expansion would promote economic development. His predecessor, Rachel Reeves, previously made the project a centerpiece of her economic strategy. However, Prime Minister Andy Burnham has avoided endorsing the plan since entering office in July. Burnham suggested that the issue should belong to Londoners, and reports revealed he told Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander that he was not convinced by the megaproject.
paragraphs.zh: 英國財政大臣約翰·希利對興建希斯洛機場第三條跑道表達了支持，主張擴建將促進經濟發展。他的前任財政大臣瑞秋·里夫斯先前曾將該計畫置於其經濟策略的核心。然而，首相安迪·伯納姆自七月上任以來一直避免公開支持該計畫。伯納姆表示該議題應由倫敦市民自行決定，且有報導指出他曾向交通大臣海蒂·亞歷山大表示，自己尚未被這項大型建設計畫說服。

paragraphs.en: Speaking in Bangkok during annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), Healey noted that airports across the United Kingdom have long generated employment and growth. Although Healey had already voted in favor of the runway in Parliament in 2018, he explained that the government would still evaluate opinions from a recently closed public consultation. Healey insisted that expanding the economy remains the primary mission for both himself and Burnham.
paragraphs.zh: 希利在曼谷出席國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）年會期間發言指出，全英國各地的機場長期以來創造了就業機會與成長。儘管希利早於2018年在國會就已對該跑道投下贊成票，但他解釋政府仍會評估剛結束的公眾諮詢意見。希利堅稱，擴展經濟仍是他與伯納姆在政府中的首要任務。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Heathrow's chief executive, Thomas Woldbye, warned that "we cannot wait for ever" as investors might reconsider their financial backing for the £33 billion project. The airport is owned by international entities, including sovereign wealth funds from Qatar, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia, alongside the French firm Ardian. These investors are expected to decide in the coming months whether to submit an official planning application.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，希斯洛機場執行長湯瑪斯·沃德拜警告「我們不可能永遠等下去」，因為投資人可能會重新評估對這項耗資330億英鎊工程的資金支持。該機場由多家國際機構共同持有，包括來自卡達、新加坡和沙烏地阿拉伯的主權財富基金，以及法國的阿爾迪安公司。預計這些投資者將在未來幾個月內決定是否提交正式的規劃申請。

paragraphs.en: Healey has now returned to London to prepare his budget for October 28. During the Bangkok conference, the IMF commended the UK for taking steps to reduce its financial deficit, and the organization's managing director, Kristalina Georgieva, urged him to stay on course. Furthermore, official statistics showed that the British economy experienced unexpected growth in August, providing positive momentum before the upcoming budget announcement.
paragraphs.zh: 希利現已返回倫敦，準備他定於10月28日提出的預算案。在曼谷會議期間，國際貨幣基金組織讚揚英國採取措施縮減財政赤字，該組織總裁克里斯塔利娜·喬治艾娃並敦促他堅持既定方針。此外，官方統計資料顯示英國經濟在八月意外維持成長，為即將公布的預算案增添了正向動能。

lessons.title: Brazilian Amazon deforestation falls to lowest on record as pivotal vote looms
lessons.title_zh: 關鍵投票逼近之際 巴西亞馬遜森林砍伐率降至有紀錄以來最低

paragraphs.en: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon has dropped to the lowest point since record-keeping began in 1988. Satellite figures from the National Institute for Space Research revealed that forest loss decreased by 41.8% over the past year to 3,335 square kilometers. This achievement beat the prior record low by an area roughly equal to the size of Rio de Janeiro. Since 2022, before President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva began his term, the clearance rate has declined by 71.2%, largely due to stricter legal enforcement and greater funding for environmental agencies.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西亞馬遜地區的森林砍伐已降至自1988年開始記錄以來的最低點。來自國家太空研究院（National Institute for Space Research）的衛星資料顯示，過去一年中森林流失量減少了41.8%，降至3,335平方公里。這項成就比先前的歷史新低還多減少了相當於里約熱內盧（Rio de Janeiro）面積大小的林地。自總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）上任前的2022年以來，砍伐率已減緩了71.2%，這主要歸功於更嚴格的法律執法以及對環保機構的更多資金挹注。

paragraphs.en: Other regions also recorded positive environmental changes. In the neighboring Cerrado savannah, which has often been cleared for cattle and soybeans, annual tree destruction fell to 5,516 square kilometers, the lowest level since 2001. Deforestation dropped by over 45% in Brazil's most affected states, such as Pará and Mato Grosso. However, tree loss rose by 0.4% in Roraima, an area known as a stronghold for the political opposition.
paragraphs.zh: 其他地區也記錄到了正面的環境轉變。在鄰近常被清理以蓄養牛隻和種植大豆的塞拉多（Cerrado）熱帶莽原，年度樹木破壞量降至5,516平方公里，是自2001年以來的最低水準。在巴西受影響最嚴重的州，例如帕拉州（Pará）和馬托格羅索州（Mato Grosso），森林砍伐率下降了超過45%。然而，在被視為政治反對派大本營的羅賴馬州（Roraima），林地流失卻上升了0.4%。

paragraphs.en: These successes contrast sharply with the administration of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who oversaw a nearly 60% increase in Amazon destruction. Jair Bolsonaro was later convicted for attempting a coup, but his son, Flávio Bolsonaro, is now competing against Lula in a critical presidential run-off election on 25 October. While Lula views the rainforest as a sovereign treasure that protects Indigenous people and slows climate change, Flávio Bolsonaro has courted destructive landowners and extractivist businesses.
paragraphs.zh: 這些成功與前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）執政時期形成鮮明對比，他在任內見證了亞馬遜破壞量增加了近60%。波索納洛後來因企圖發動政變而被定罪，但他的兒子弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）如今在10月25日關鍵的總統決選中與魯拉競爭。魯拉將這座雨林視為能保護原住民並減緩氣候變遷的主權珍寶，而弗拉維奧·波索納洛則向具破壞性的地主和資源開採業者示好。

paragraphs.en: The upcoming vote will determine whether these environmental gains continue. Conservation groups warn that a change in leadership could reverse recent progress and renew threats to the rainforest. Regarding these new statistics, Marcio Astrini, the executive secretary of the Climate Observatory, stated, "putting an end to forest destruction in Brazil is entirely possible." Voters must now decide the fate of their nation's natural heritage.
paragraphs.zh: 即將到來的投票將決定這些環境成果是否得以延續。保育團體警告，領導階層的更迭可能會逆轉近期的進展，並使雨林再次面臨威脅。針對這些新資料，氣候觀測站（Climate Observatory）執行秘書馬西奧·阿斯特里尼（Marcio Astrini）表示：「在巴西終結森林破壞是完全有可能的。」選民現在必須決定國家自然遺產的命運。

lessons.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
lessons.title_zh: 有毒演算法糾纏不休——如今澳洲想設下關閉開關

paragraphs.en: Many young people experience serious harm from recommender algorithms on social media. In Australia, Varsha Yajman battled an eating disorder as a teenager after platforms constantly showed her dangerous diet challenges. In another case, Flynn Martin was drawn into toxic and hateful online groups while dealing with mental health struggles. Both individuals believe that automated content recommendations played a key role during the most painful chapters of their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 許多青少年在社群媒體上面臨推薦演算法帶來的嚴重傷害。在澳洲，瓦莎·亞吉曼（Varsha Yajman）在青少年時期於平台不斷向她展示危險的節食挑戰後，陷入了飲食失調的痛苦掙扎。在另一個案例中，弗林·馬丁（Flynn Martin）在面對心理健康問題的同時，被吸入了有害且充滿仇恨的網路群體中。兩人都認為，自動化的內容推薦在他們人生中最痛苦的篇章中扮演了關鍵角色。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, the Australian government recently introduced a new suite of laws to parliament. The central proposal is an algorithm switch that would require platforms to let users turn off recommended posts. This change would allow people to see only updates from accounts they actually follow. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese defended the idea, stating, "This is not about giving government control, it is about giving people control."
paragraphs.zh: 為了解決這些問題，澳洲政府最近向國會提交了一套新法案。其核心提案是一項演算法開關，要求平台允許使用者關閉推薦內容。這項改變將讓人們只能看到自己實際追蹤的帳號所發布的動態。總理安東尼·艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）為此構想辯護時表示：「這不是給政府控制權，而是給人民控制權。」

paragraphs.en: The policy was inspired by activist Chanel Contos, who led a public campaign called "Fix Our Feeds." Her petition attracted more than 15,000 signatures along with support from lawmakers and mental health advocates. The proposal is included in the Digital Duty of Care bill, which forces online platforms, gaming websites, and chatbots to ensure safety. Tech companies that violate these standards could face fines of up to 100 million Australian dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 這項政策受到了倡議者夏奈爾·康托斯（Chanel Contos）的啟發，她發起了一場名為「修正我們的動態」的公開運動。她的請願書吸引了超過一萬五千人簽署，並獲得立法委員和心理健康倡議人士的支持。這項提案被納入《數位注意義務法案》，該法案強制網路平台、遊戲網站及聊天機器人確保安全環境。違反這些標準的科技公司可能面臨最高一億澳幣的罰款。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, the plan faces significant debate and practical challenges. Critics, including the Trump administration, argue that the legislation threatens free speech and might cause excessive censorship. Furthermore, tech experts point to the European Union, where similar controls produced poor results because platforms created clunky interfaces that discouraged users. As Australia prepares to enforce the new law, observers wonder whether it can truly solve the problem of digital addiction.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，這項計畫仍面臨重大爭論與實際挑戰。包括川普政府在內的批評者主張，該法案威脅了言論自由，並可能導致過度審查。此外，科技專家指出歐盟的例子，當地類似的管制措施成效不佳，因為平台設計了笨拙難用的介面，讓使用者打退堂鼓。隨著澳洲準備執行這項新法律，觀察人士質疑它是否真能解決數位成癮的問題。

lessons.title: Hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia – OB-GYNS set new rules for menopause treatment
lessons.title_zh: 潮熱、盜汗、失眠——婦產科醫師為更年期治療訂定新準則

paragraphs.en: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) has updated its guidelines for treating menopause symptoms for the first time since 2014. Millions of women experience problems such as hot flashes, night sweats, sleep loss, and mood swings. To address these issues, the medical group now recommends hormone replacement therapy (HRT) alongside newer nonhormonal medicines and lifestyle changes, giving doctors more options to create personalized care plans.
paragraphs.zh: 美國婦產科醫學會（ACOG）自2014年以來，首次更新了更年期症狀的治療指引。數百萬名女性經歷著潮熱、盜汗、睡眠障礙以及情緒起伏等困擾。為了應對這些問題，該醫療組織現在建議將荷爾蒙替代療法（HRT）與較新的非荷爾蒙藥物及生活型態改變搭配使用，讓醫師有更多選擇來制定個人化的照護計畫。

paragraphs.en: In 2002, an earlier study raised serious concerns that HRT might increase the risk of heart disease, stroke, and breast cancer. However, researchers later reexamined the data and discovered significant limitations. For example, most participants in that study were 60 or older, so the findings could not represent younger women. Co-author Dr. Robert Kauffman stated that hormone therapy remains the best choice for symptomatic women who recently entered menopause or are younger than 60.
paragraphs.zh: 2002年，一項早期的研究引發了嚴重擔憂，認為荷爾蒙替代療法可能增加心臟病、中風和乳癌的風險。然而，研究人員後來重新檢視了資料，發現了重大的局限性。舉例來說，該研究中的大多數參與者年齡都在60歲或以上，因此這些發現無法代表較年輕的女性。共同作者羅伯特·考夫曼醫師（Dr. Robert Kauffman）指出，對於有症狀且剛進入更年期或年齡小於60歲的女性而言，荷爾蒙療法仍然是最佳選擇。

paragraphs.en: Under the new guidance, women who still have a uterus should receive both estrogen and progestogen because progestogen protects the uterine lining from cancer. Women without a uterus may take estrogen alone. However, people with certain health conditions, including liver disease, blood clots, or a history of stroke, should avoid hormone therapy. For those who cannot use hormones, doctors suggest newer drugs like fezolinetant or medicines such as gabapentin.
paragraphs.zh: 在新指引下，仍有子宮的女性應同時接受雌激素與黃體素，因為黃體素能保護子宮內膜免於罹癌。沒有子宮的女性則可以單獨使用雌激素。然而，患有特定健康狀況的人，包括肝臟疾病、血栓或有中風病史者，應避免接受荷爾蒙治療。對於不能使用荷爾蒙的人，醫師建議使用如非唑奈坦（fezolinetant）等較新的藥物，或如加巴噴丁（gabapentin）這類的藥物。

paragraphs.en: Lifestyle modifications can also help relieve mild discomfort. According to ACOG, regular exercise, a balanced diet, and cognitive behavioral therapy can support patients, even though the scientific evidence for these methods is weaker than that for HRT. Due to growing demand, some estrogen products have recently faced shortages. Therefore, health experts urge women to discuss both benefits and risks with trusted doctors instead of focusing on a single treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 改變生活型態也有助於緩解輕微的不適。根據美國婦產科醫學會的說法，規律運動、均衡飲食和認知行為治療能為患者提供幫助，儘管這些方法的科學證據比荷爾蒙替代療法來得弱。由於需求不斷增長，一些雌激素產品近期面臨短缺。因此，健康專家呼籲女性應與值得信賴的醫師討論優缺點，而非只專注於單一治療選擇。

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用「To + 原形動詞」表示目的，用來說明採取後續行動的原因，語意為「為了應對這些問題」。
grammar.example: To address these issues, the medical group now recommends hormone replacement therapy (HRT) alongside newer nonhormonal medicines and lifestyle changes, giving doctors more options to create personalized care plans.

lessons.title: Our business ads were taken down for saying 'pregnancy' on Instagram
lessons.title_zh: 我們的商業廣告在Instagram上因為提到「懷孕」而被下架

paragraphs.en: In early 2025, business owner Irene Breen received a surprising notification stating that Instagram was removing advertisements for her company's pregnancy pillows. She later learned from Meta, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, that the issue was the specific word included in her product name. To fix this problem, she had to completely clear that term from her entire website and rename her web addresses. Although the platform eventually lifted these restrictions after ten months of communication, her company suffered a significant financial loss during this period.
paragraphs.zh: 在2025年初期，企業主愛琳·布林收到了一則令人驚訝的通知，指出Instagram正在移除她公司懷孕枕頭的廣告。她後來從Instagram和Facebook的母公司Meta得知，問題在於她產品名稱中包含的這個特定詞彙。為了解決這個問題，她必須從整個網站中完全清除該詞彙並重新命名她的網址。雖然該平台在經過十個月的溝通後終於解除這些限制，但她的公司在這段期間遭受了重大的財務損失。

paragraphs.en: Meta explained that while businesses are permitted to promote wellness and reproductive items, rules exist to prevent users from having negative experiences across different cultures. However, the company later clarified that individuals are allowed to freely use the term in regular posts and discussions. Despite this explanation, many creators and charities focusing on women's health report that their materials are frequently removed, hidden by sensitivity filters, or affected by a practice known as shadowbanning.
paragraphs.zh: Meta解釋說，雖然企業被允許推廣健康和生殖用品，但存在相關規定以防止使用者在不同文化中擁有負面體驗。然而，該公司隨後澄清，個人被允許在一般貼文和討論中自由使用該詞彙。儘管有此解釋，許多專注於女性健康的創作者和慈善機構回報，他們的資料經常被移除、被敏感度過濾器隱藏，或是受到被稱為「影子禁言」的做法影響。

paragraphs.en: A campaign group named CensHERship recently published a report surveying nearly two hundred creators, health brands, and educators, with ninety-six percent stating they had faced various content restrictions. Experts note that platforms often rely on automated artificial intelligence systems to check posts against guidelines. Unfortunately, this technology can make mistakes and repeat previous errors without giving users a proper way to question the decision.
paragraphs.zh: 名為CensHERship的倡議團體最近發布了一份報告，調查了將近兩百位創作者、健康品牌和教育工作者，其中百分之九十六表示他們曾面臨各種內容限制。專家指出，平台經常依賴自動化的人工智慧系統來對照準則檢查貼文。不幸的是，這項科技可能會犯錯並重複先前的錯誤，卻沒有給使用者適當的管道來質疑該決定。

paragraphs.en: For instance, Athena Lamnisos, the chief executive officer of the gynaecological cancer charity Eve Appeal, shared that an educational diagram about vulval anatomy and cancer was pulled down by the platform. Although the post eventually reappeared behind a sensitivity filter after a lengthy appeal process, critical health information is still failing to reach people who need it urgently. Similarly, Deirdre O'Neill from the fertility test company Hertility reported that a video simply describing a woman's pain with endometriosis was incorrectly classified as political content and removed.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，婦科癌症慈善機構「Eve Appeal」的執行長雅典娜·拉姆尼索斯分享說，一張關於外陰解剖結構與癌症的教育圖表被該平台撤下。儘管該貼文在經過漫長的申訴流程後，最終在敏感度過濾器後方重新出現，但關鍵的健康資訊依然未能傳達給急需之的人。同樣地，來自生育檢測公司Hertility的迪爾德麗·奧尼爾回報，一段單純描述女性子宮內膜異位症痛苦的影片被錯誤分類為政治內容並遭到移除。

paragraphs.en: As a result of these strict moderation practices, a growing number of respondents are turning to self-censorship, such as using alternative spellings, emojis, or avoiding specific topics entirely. Representatives from advocacy groups warn that this trend is deeply damaging because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health. While social media companies claim they are consulting with health organizations to improve their systems, advocates emphasize that much work remains to be done to ensure important educational content is no longer suppressed.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些嚴格的審查做法，越來越多的受訪者轉向自我審查，例如使用替代拼法、表情符號，或完全避開特定主題。倡議團體的代表警告說，這種趨勢具有極大的破壞力，因為它強化了圍繞著女性健康的歷史羞恥感與罪惡感。雖然社群媒體公司聲稱他們正與健康組織諮詢以改善其系統，但倡議人士強調，仍有許多工作需要完成，以確保重要的教育內容不再被壓制。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為「be 動詞 + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: To fix this problem, she had to completely clear that term from her entire website and rename her web addresses.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 who 來引導子句，修飾前面的先行詞 creators and charities。
grammar.example: Despite this explanation, many creators and charities focusing on women's health report that their materials are frequently removed...

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial Clause of Reason)
grammar.explain: 用來表達動作發生的原因，在此處由連接詞 because 引導。
grammar.example: Representatives from advocacy groups warn that this trend is deeply damaging because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health.
grammar.focus: because it reinforces historical shame and guilt surrounding women's health

lessons.title: US voters want more action on global heating. Why are Democrats and Republicans staying silent?
lessons.title_zh: 美國選民希望採取更多行動應對全球暖化。為什麼民主黨人和共和黨人卻保持沈默？

paragraphs.en: Public opinion polls across the United States indicate that voters in battleground states want candidates to discuss the climate crisis more openly. Although Americans have experienced extreme summer heat and soaring household expenses, politicians from both major parties have largely avoided the topic during midterm election campaigns. This phenomenon of climate hushing contradicts what voters actually desire, as large surveys reveal that a majority of citizens in swing states favor candidates who support a transition to clean energy.
paragraphs.zh: 全美各地的民意調查顯示，關鍵搖擺州的選民希望候選人更公開地討論氣候危機。儘管美國人經歷了極端的夏季高溫與飆升的家庭開支，兩大黨的政治人物在期中選舉競選期間卻大體上避開了这个議題。這種氣候噤聲的現象與選民的真實期望相矛盾，大型調查顯示，搖擺州的多數公民偏好支持轉型至清潔能源的候選人。

paragraphs.en: In states that could determine control of the US Senate, candidates have frequently dropped environmental mentions from their platforms. For example, Democratic Senate hopefuls in states such as Georgia and Texas have shifted their focus toward inflation and the oil and gas industry. Political figures argue that avoiding the topic helps them secure broader appeal, fearing that addressing global heating might cost them valuable votes among independent and conservative citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 在可能決定美國參議院控制權的州中，候選人經常從其政綱中刪除對環境的提及。例如，在喬治亞州和德州等地的民主黨參議院希望人已將焦點轉向通貨膨脹以及石油和天然氣產業。政治人物主張，避開這個話題有助於他們獲得更廣泛的支持，因為他們擔心談論全球暖化可能會讓他們失去獨立選民和保守派公民的重要選票。

paragraphs.en: However, research conducted by experts suggests that this strategy is misguided. Data shows that voters are increasingly connecting rising living costs with fossil fuels and weather-related disasters. Experts note that treating clean energy as a radical concept is outdated, because communities across the country continue to suffer from severe weather events. Many citizens believe that strong leadership on this issue could actually win elections rather than lose them.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，專家進行的研究表明這種策略是錯誤的。數據顯示，選民越來越將不斷上升的生活成本與化石燃料及氣候相關災害連結在一起。專家指出，將清潔能源視為激進的概念已經過時，因為全國各地的社區持續遭受劇烈天氣事件的之苦。許多公民相信，在這個議題上的強勢領導實際上能贏得選舉而非輸掉選舉。

paragraphs.en: Despite these findings, prominent figures within the Republican Party continue to dismiss climate science, while some Democratic candidates struggle to address the vulnerability of their home regions. Figures like Angie Nixon in Florida have attempted to break the silence by warning about rising sea levels that threaten local communities. Nevertheless, many politicians remain hesitant to confront the problem directly, leaving numerous voters disappointed as they deal with the ongoing impacts of extreme weather.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些發現，共和黨內的知名人士仍然對氣候科學不屑一顧，而一些民主黨候選人則努力應對其家鄉地區的脆弱性。像佛羅里達州的安吉·尼克森（Angie Nixon）這樣的人物試圖透過警告威脅當地社區的海平面上升來打破沈默。然而，許多政治人物仍然對直接面對這個問題感到猶豫，當他們處理極端天氣帶來的持續衝擊時，讓許多選民感到失望。

vocab.zh: 兵家必爭之地的；競爭激烈的

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 voters 的特徵，用 who 引導形容詞子句修飾前面的名詞。
grammar.example: Data shows that voters are increasingly connecting rising living costs with fossil fuels and weather-related disasters.
grammar.focus: that voters are increasingly connecting rising living costs with fossil fuels and weather-related disasters

grammar.point: 不定詞作副詞用表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 說明警告海平面上升的動機與目的。
grammar.example: Figures like Angie Nixon in Florida have attempted to break the silence by warning about rising sea levels that threaten local communities.

grammar.explain: 說明研究是由專家所進行的，強調動作的承受者。

lessons.title: New wildfire in Southern California explodes in size, burning multiple homes
lessons.title_zh: 南加州新野火規模暴增，燒毀多棟民宅

paragraphs.en: A dangerous wildfire in Southern California grew rapidly on Friday afternoon, burning several homes and covering hundreds of acres. Named the Norte Fire, the blaze started around noon in Orange County and expanded to 465 acres. Strong Santa Ana winds have fueled multiple fires across the region since Thursday.
paragraphs.zh: 南加州一場危險的野火在週五下午迅速擴大，燒毀了數棟民宅並吞噬了數百英畝土地。這場被命名為諾特大火（Norte Fire）的火災於週五中午左右在橘郡爆發，並擴大至465英畝。強勁的聖塔安娜風自週四以來助長了該地區的多起火災。

paragraphs.en: Television footage showed several houses in flames, and officials stated that four homes in San Juan Capistrano were damaged. Authorities ordered people in five specific zones across San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano to evacuate immediately. To keep residents safe, sheriff deputies went directly from house to house to urge families to leave, while shelters were prepared in local community centers.
paragraphs.zh: 電視畫面顯示有數棟房屋起火，官員表示聖胡安卡皮斯特拉諾有四棟住宅遭到波及。當局已下令聖克萊門特和聖胡安卡皮斯特拉諾的五個特定區域立即撤離。為了確保居民安全，警長辦公室副警長們挨家挨戶催促家庭離開，同時當地社區中心也設立了收容所。

paragraphs.en: Due to safety concerns, ten local schools ended classes early, and after-school activities were called off. Wind gusts reached 25 miles per hour in the area. Forecasters predicted the winds would remain strong until Friday evening before slowing down near the coast, though elevated conditions would continue into Saturday.
paragraphs.zh: 基於安全考量，當地十所學校提前放學，課後活動也被取消。該地區陣風達到每小時25英里。氣象預報員預測強風將持續到週五晚間，隨後在靠近海岸的地區才會減弱，儘管較強的風勢仍將持續至週六。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, another blaze called the Bryson Fire was threatening communities in Malibu. It started on Thursday evening, burning about 150 acres, and was only 17 percent contained. Thousands of structures were in evacuation zones, and hundreds of residents were told to flee. More than 400 firefighters responded to this blaze. One firefighter suffered minor injuries and went to the hospital after working on the fire lines all night.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，另一場名為布萊森大火（Bryson Fire）的火勢正威脅著馬里布的社區。它於週四傍晚開始延燒約150英畝，且僅有17%受到控制。數千棟建築物處於疏散區內，數百名居民被要求逃離。超過400名消防員前往應對這場火災。一名消防員在火線奮戰整夜後受了輕傷並送醫治療。

paragraphs.en: Los Angeles County Fire Chief Anthony Marrone said crews made "great progress" overnight. However, he warned that stronger winds could cause firefighters to lose control of the perimeter, putting a wider area at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 洛杉磯郡消防局局長安東尼·馬羅尼表示，工作人員在一夜之間取得了「巨大進展」。然而，他警告說更強的風勢可能會導致消防人員失去對火場周邊的控制，從而使更廣泛的地區面臨危險。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語作後置修飾語 (Past Participial Phrase as Postmodifier)
grammar.explain: 由過去分詞引導的片語置於名詞之後，用來補充說明該名詞的被動狀態或名稱。
grammar.example: Named the Norte Fire, the blaze started around noon in Orange County and expanded to 465 acres.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to 引導的不定詞片語用來表達執行主要子句動作的目的，意思為「為了……」。
grammar.example: To keep residents safe, sheriff deputies went directly from house to house to urge families to leave, while shelters were prepared in local community centers.

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導的名詞子句，在主要動詞 warned 後面作為受詞使用。
grammar.example: However, he warned that stronger winds could cause firefighters to lose control of the perimeter, putting a wider area at risk.
grammar.focus: that stronger winds could cause firefighters to lose control of the perimeter

lessons.title: What happens if AI agents start speaking their own language?
lessons.title_zh: 如果人工智慧代理開始說自己的語言會發生什麼事？

paragraphs.en: Part of Chris Painter’s work is to investigate artificial intelligence (AI) when it misbehaves. He helps lead METR, a non-profit research organization. Recently, METR assisted OpenAI in analyzing the Hugging Face hack, and Painter spoke before a Senate subcommittee. To examine such problems, researchers study "chain-of-thought" logs. These written records reveal the logical steps that AI bots take before they answer questions or complete tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 克里斯‧潘特（Chris Painter）的部分工作是在人工智慧（AI）出現失控行為時進行調查。他協助領導非營利研究組織 METR。最近，METR 協助 OpenAI 分析了 Hugging Face 的駭客攻擊事件，而潘特也在參議院小組委員會前發言。為了檢驗此類問題，研究人員會研究「思考鏈」（chain of thought）記錄。這些書面記錄揭示了 AI 機器人在回答問題或完成任務之前所採取的邏輯步驟。

paragraphs.en: However, researchers worry that monitoring AI could soon become much harder. Chain-of-thought data allows humans to spot dishonest actions, such as hacking. But what if AI begins using its own communication system? Painter warned that an investigator might find that "it’ll all just be numbers everywhere." Mark Riedl, a professor at the Georgia Institute of Technology, explains that models could create shorthand notes to work faster, which would look like complete gibberish to humans.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，研究人員擔心監控 AI 可能很快會變得困難得多。思考鏈資料使人類能夠發現不誠實的行為，例如駭客入侵。但如果 AI 開始使用自己的通訊系統呢？潘特警告，調查人員可能會發現「到處都只會是數字」。喬治亞理工學院教授馬克‧里德爾（Mark Riedl）解釋說，模型可能會建立速記筆記以便工作得更快，而這在人類看來會像是完全不知所云的胡言亂語。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, newer models might stop recording their thinking process altogether. Jacob Andreas, an associate professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), notes that an AI system might skip readable English to save time or power. In fact, OpenAI reported that its new Astra model could achieve goals without writing down its thoughts. As a result, monitoring tools become less capable of catching actions that conflict with human values.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，較新的模型可能會完全停止記錄其思考過程。麻省理工學院（MIT）副教授雅各布‧安德烈亞斯（Jacob Andreas）指出，AI 系統可能會為了節省時間或電力而省略可讀的英文。事實上，OpenAI 報告指出其新款 Astra 模型可以在不寫下思考過程的情況下達成目標。結果，監控工具捕捉與人類價值觀相牴觸之行為的能力變得更低。

paragraphs.en: Even when logs are available, they merely show what an AI did rather than explaining why it made that choice. In addition, checking thousands of words produced by multiple bots can easily overwhelm human inspectors. Despite these serious challenges, Painter remains hopeful. He believes recent incidents have finally pushed the global community to pay attention to the safety of rogue AI.
paragraphs.zh: 即使有記錄可用，它們也僅顯示 AI 做了什麼，而沒有解釋它為何做出該選擇。此外，檢查由多個機器人產生的數千字內容很容易讓人類檢查人員難以負荷。儘管面臨這些嚴峻的挑戰，潘特仍然抱持希望。他認為最近的事件終於促使全球社會關注失控 AI 的安全性問題。

vocab.zh: 使難以承受；使應接不暇

grammar.point: 「關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)」
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在此引導形容詞子句以修飾先行詞 steps，並在子句中作動詞 take 的受詞。
grammar.example: These written records reveal the logical steps that AI bots take before they answer questions or complete tasks.

grammar.point: 「不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)」
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to work faster 在句中表示目的，說明模型建立速記是為了提升運作速度。
grammar.example: Mark Riedl, a professor at the Georgia Institute of Technology, explains that models could create shorthand notes to work faster, which would look like complete gibberish to humans.

grammar.point: 「名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)」
grammar.explain: 由疑問代名詞 what 引導的名詞子句在句中作動詞 show 的受詞，表示 AI 所採取的具體行動。
grammar.example: Even when logs are available, they merely show what an AI did rather than explaining why it made that choice.

lessons.title: Elon Musk reveals ‘world’s first flying car’ at Tesla event
lessons.title_zh: 馬斯克在特斯拉活動中展示「世界首款飛行車」

paragraphs.en: Elon Musk has revealed Tesla’s newest model at a recent event, stating that the vehicle will function as the world’s first flying car. The billionaire hosted a demonstration for the Tesla Roadster 2 at a rocket development and testing facility located in Texas. During the presentation, he claimed that the sports car uses aerospace technology to fly much like a rocket.
paragraphs.zh: 伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在最近的一場活動中發表了特斯拉（Tesla）的最新車款，並表示該車輛將成為世界上第一位飛行車。這位億萬富翁在德州的一處火箭開發與測試設施舉辦了特斯拉 Roadster 2 的展示會。在發表過程中，他聲稱這輛跑車使用了航太技術，能像火箭一樣飛行。

paragraphs.en: A video shown during the event displayed the remote-controlled sports car driving up a curved ramp. The vehicle used suction to grip upside down before deploying thrusters to flip, fly, and land safely. Later in the same demonstration, the Roadster used its jets to jump over a line of existing Tesla models and accelerated rapidly.
paragraphs.zh: 活動中播放的一段影片展示了這輛受遠端控制的跑車行駛上彎曲的斜坡。該車輛利用吸力以倒掛姿勢抓住坡道，隨後部署推進器進行翻轉、飛行與降落。在稍後的同一場展示中，這 Roadster 利用其噴射推進器飛越了一排現有的特斯拉車款並快速加速。

paragraphs.en: While sharing a video from the event on his social media site, Musk pointed out that flying cars are finally real. He explained that the vehicle features altitude controls and multiple thrusters to perform complex gymnastics in the air. However, he also admitted that the prototype might not be legal in all jurisdictions and is not necessarily a safety-optimized car.
paragraphs.zh: 馬斯克在自己的社群媒體網站 X 上分享了來自該活動的影片時指出，飛行車終於成真了。他解釋該車輛具備高度控制與多個推進器，能在空中做出複雜的體操動作。不過，他也坦言這款原型車可能並非在所有管轄區都合法，且不見得是一輛經過安全最佳化的汽車。

paragraphs.en: Previously, the businessman had expressed doubt about a future involving flying vehicles. Despite that past hesitation, he announced the development of the Roadster 2 three years later. The upcoming electric sports car will go into production in the year 2028 with a high price tag to compete strongly against gasoline-powered cars.
paragraphs.zh: 此前，這位企業家曾對充滿飛行載具的未來表達過懷疑。儘管有過過去的猶豫，他在三年後仍宣佈了 Roadster 2 的開發計畫。這款即將推出的電動跑車將於 2028 年投入生產，並帶有高昂的價格標籤，旨在強力競爭汽油車。

paragraphs.en: Following the event, the company set up reservation options requiring different deposits based on the vehicle version. A performance model requires a large deposit, while a thrust version needs an even higher amount. Furthermore, a single-seater rocket variant equipped with a full flight system is available solely by invitation, and the company noted that flying it on public roads is prohibited.
paragraphs.zh: 活動結束後，該公司設置了預訂選項，根據車輛版本需要不同的訂金。性能車型需要大筆訂金，而推進版本則需要更高的金額。此外，配備完整飛行系統的單人座火箭變體僅限透過邀請購買，且該公司指出在公路上飛行它是被禁止的。

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用 to 不定詞片語來表達採取某個動作的目的（為了翻轉、飛行與降落）。
grammar.example: The vehicle used suction to grip upside down before deploying thrusters to flip, fly, and land safely.

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)

lessons.title: School's plan to use toilet chaperones puts pupils at risk, says campaigner
lessons.title_zh: 學校計畫派人陪同上廁所將使學生陷入危險，活動人士表示

paragraphs.en: A school in Wales has faced severe criticism after introducing a controversial policy where certain students are escorted to the bathroom during class time. Ebbw Fawr Learning Community in Blaenau Gwent started this new practice to stop expensive property damage and reduce the amount of time pupils spend away from their classrooms.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯一所學校在實施一項爭議政策後面臨嚴厲批評，該政策規定某些學生在上課期間必須被護送去洗手間。位於布萊耐格溫特的埃布沃福爾學習社群開始這項新做法，是為了阻止昂貴的財產損壞，並減少學生離開教室的時間。

paragraphs.en: Initially, the institution announced that all secondary-age students asking to use the toilet during lessons would be accompanied by a pastoral team member. Following a meeting with fifty student representatives, the school adjusted the rule. The chaperone requirement now applies only to learners who persistently arrive late or fall under stage three of the behavior policy.
paragraphs.zh: 最初，該機構宣布所有請求在上課期間使用廁所的中學年齡學生，都將由牧養團隊成員陪同。在與五十名學生代表會面後，學校調整了規定。陪同要求現在僅適用於持續遲到或屬於行為政策第三階段的學習者。

paragraphs.en: However, Molly Fenton, who founded the Love Your Period campaign, strongly condemned the decision. The twenty-four-year-old activist warned that making students walk with a chaperone could discourage them from asking for help with health matters like periods. She stated that such rules put students at risk by increasing the shame and stigma surrounding natural bodily functions.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，創辦「愛你的經期」運動的茉莉·芬頓強烈譴責這項決定。這位二十四歲的活動人士警告說，讓學生由人陪同走路可能會阻礙他們尋求經期等健康問題的幫助。她表示，這樣的規定透過增加圍繞自然身體功能的羞恥感與汙名，將學生置於危險之中。

paragraphs.en: Fenton shared her own difficult school experiences, recalling times when she suffered from severe periods and did not know how to handle the situation. She noted that many young people already feel too embarrassed to use school facilities properly. Furthermore, she pointed out that trust in authority has declined among youth, meaning students would find it hard to confide in an assigned chaperone.
paragraphs.zh: 芬頓分享了她自己困難的學校經驗，回憶起她遭受嚴重經期且不知如何處理情況的時刻。她指出，許多青年已經感到太尷尬而無法正常使用學校設施。此外，她指出青年對權威的信任已經下降，這意味著學生會發現很難向指定的陪同人員吐露心聲。

paragraphs.en: In response, the learning community explained that a small minority of pupils had caused thousands of pounds in damages through recent vandalism. The new arrangements were specifically designed to target the lesson times right before and after lunch when these negative incidents happened most often.
paragraphs.zh: 作為回應，該學習社群解釋說，極少數學生透過最近的破壞行為造成了數千英鎊的損失。這些新安排專門旨在針對午餐前後最常發生這些負面事件的上課時間。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞 Molly Fenton，補充說明其身分。
grammar.example: However, Molly Fenton, who founded the Love Your Period campaign, strongly condemned the decision.
grammar.focus: who founded the Love Your Period campaign

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 表示主詞 The new arrangements 承受設計動作，強調專門針對特定時間。
grammar.example: The new arrangements were specifically designed to target the lesson times right before and after lunch when these negative incidents happened most often.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表示開始這項新做法的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: Ebbw Fawr Learning Community in Blaenau Gwent started this new practice to stop expensive property damage and reduce the amount of time pupils spend away from their classrooms.

lessons.title: Public health nurse talks about the moment she learned to ask for help
lessons.title_zh: 公衛護士談論她學會尋求協助的那一刻

paragraphs.en: Afaf Saleh, a public health nurse in Minnesota who is the daughter of Somali immigrants, recently spoke with her college mentor about a time she almost quit her nursing career. More than a decade ago, she faced overwhelming responsibilities while studying in nursing school.
paragraphs.zh: 明尼蘇達州的公衛護士阿法·薩利赫（Afaf Saleh）是索馬利亞移民的女兒，她最近與大學導師談論了一次她差點放棄護理職涯的經歷。十多年前，她在就讀護理學校時面臨了排山倒海的責任。

paragraphs.en: At that time, Saleh was working full-time, acting as a stand-in mother, and managing nearly everything for her family, including her seven siblings and her ailing mother. The extreme pressure eventually caused her to fail a class, leading to notice that she would be dismissed from the nursing program.
paragraphs.zh: 當時，薩利赫從事全職工作，扮演代理母親的角色，並為她的家人處理幾乎所有事情，包括她的七個手足和生病的母親。極大的壓力最終導致她有一門課被當掉，並接到她將被護理系退學的通知。

paragraphs.en: Facing this crisis, Saleh first prayed and then poured her heart into an appeal letter, explaining all the heavy burdens she carried as a young student. Soon after, her mentor Suzanne Burke Lehman contacted her to ask why she had stayed silent about her struggles.
paragraphs.zh: 面對這場危機，薩利赫先是祈禱，接著將滿腔心血傾注於一封申訴信中，解釋她身為年輕學生所承擔的所有沉重負擔。不久之後，她的導師蘇珊·伯克·萊曼（Suzanne Burke Lehman）聯繫她，詢問她為何對自己的困境保持沉默。

paragraphs.en: During their meeting in the office, Lehman told Saleh that she saw herself in her former student, which made Saleh realize she did not have to handle everything alone. Lehman later shared that teaching her made her realize how close help was for those who need it.
paragraphs.zh: 在辦公室會面期間，萊曼告訴薩利赫，她在這位前學生身上看到了自己的影子，這讓薩利赫意識到她不必獨自處理一切。萊曼後來分享說，教導薩利赫讓她體會到，對於需要幫助的人而言，援助其實是多麼近在咫尺。

paragraphs.en: With this vital support, Saleh ultimately graduated at the top of her class and is now a public health nurse in Minneapolis. Lehman currently serves as the dean of St. Catherine University's School of Nursing, and their inspiring conversation has been preserved at the Library of Congress.
paragraphs.zh: 有了這項關鍵支持，薩利赫最終以優異成績從班上畢業，如今在明neapolis擔任公衛護士。萊曼目前擔任聖凱瑟琳大學護理學院院長，他們深具啟發性的對話已被美國國會圖書館典藏。

lessons.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side. New Yorkers are captivated
lessons.title_zh: 一隻罕見的倉鴞家族搬進了曼哈頓上西城，紐約人為之著迷

paragraphs.en: A family of barn owls has recently made a home inside a water tower on a building in Manhattan's Upper West Side. According to a migration ecologist, this marks the first recorded instance of these birds nesting in Manhattan in modern history.
paragraphs.zh: 一隻倉鴞家族最近在曼哈頓上西城一棟建築物的水塔內築巢安家。根據一位遷徙生態學家的說法，這是現代史上首次記錄到這些鳥類在曼哈頓築巢。

paragraphs.en: The discovery began when a local resident and her husband noticed multiple owls near Central Park and notified a news outlet. Soon after, photographers and curious onlookers began gathering on the street every night to catch a glimpse of the rare birds.
paragraphs.zh: 這個發現始於一位當地居民和她的丈夫注意到中央公園附近有多隻貓頭鷹，並通報了一家新聞媒體。不久之後，攝影師和好奇的圍觀民眾開始每晚聚集在街上，希望能一睹這些罕見鳥類的風采。

paragraphs.en: Experts note that barn owl sightings are extremely rare in New York City parks because the city sits at the northern fringe of their range. Furthermore, local residents initially heard bizarre screeching noises for weeks before realizing that the sounds came from owls.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，在紐約市公園裡發現倉鴞的機率極低，因為該市位於其活動範圍的北端邊緣。此外，當地居民在意識到這些聲音是貓頭鷹發出之前，最初連續幾週聽到奇怪的尖叫聲。

paragraphs.en: Despite the strange noises, people on the Upper West Side are thrilled by the unexpected visitors. As one resident expressed, having a family breeding in Manhattan is truly special news for both bird watchers and the general public.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有奇怪的噪音，上西城的人們仍為這些意料之外的訪客感到興奮。正如一位居民所表達的，有一個家族在曼哈頓繁殖，對於賞鳥人士和大眾來說確實是特別的新聞。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 用關代which引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的先行詞a building。
grammar.example: A family of barn owls has recently made a home inside a water tower on a building in Manhattan's Upper West Side.
grammar.focus: on a building in Manhattan's Upper West Side

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞notifying引導分詞構句，補充說明前面的主詞動作。
grammar.example: The discovery began when a local resident and her husband noticed multiple owls near Central Park and notified a news outlet.

lessons.title: Living with a stink? Technology might help
lessons.title_zh: 忍受惡臭生活？科技或許能幫上忙

paragraphs.en: In Milpitas, an affluent city in California, residents have suffered from unpleasant smells for decades because of nearby industrial sites and a huge landfill. Local tech engineer Chia-Ling Kong could not open her windows for ten years. Recently, officials ordered the landfill operators to install monitors and use drones to systematically track odor-causing chemicals.
paragraphs.zh: 在加州富裕城市密爾比達（Milpitas），居民數十年來一直忍受著來自附近工業區和一座龐大垃圾掩埋場的難聞氣味。當地的科技工程師 Chia-Ling Kong 甚至有十年無法打開窗戶。最近，官員已命令該掩埋場的營運單位安裝監測器並使用無人機，有系統地追蹤引發惡臭的化學物質。

paragraphs.en: Communities around the world face similar issues from rubbish dumps, sewage works, and factories. As cities expand through urban sprawl, homes are being built closer to smelly facilities. Resolving these complaints is complicated because many governments lack rules for smells. For instance, the US Environmental Protection Agency does not treat environmental odours as pollutants, leaving local authorities to handle complaints.
paragraphs.zh: 世界各地的社區也面臨著來自垃圾場、污水處理廠與工廠的類似問題。隨著城市透過都市擴張迅速拓展，住宅被蓋在距離散發臭味的設施更近的地方。解決這些投訴相當複雜，因為許多政府缺乏管理異味的規定。舉例來說，美國環境保護局並未將環境氣味視為污染物，使得地方政府必須自行處理投訴。

paragraphs.en: Technology offers several ways to tackle industrial smells, such as absorbing them, changing them chemically, or burning them away. While advanced systems can remove most bad compounds, they are expensive. Some operators choose cheaper methods like spraying large amounts of deodorisers, but experts doubt that these air fresheners can truly solve the problem, especially for massive landfills.
paragraphs.zh: 科技提供了幾種解決工業臭味的方法，例如吸收臭味、透過化學反應轉化臭味，或是將其燃燒消滅。雖然先進的系統可以消除大部分引發臭味的化合物，但成本相當高昂。有些營運商選擇較便宜的方法，例如噴灑大量除臭劑，但專家懷疑這些芳香劑是否真能解決問題，特別是對於廣大的垃圾掩埋場而言。

paragraphs.en: In Des Moines, Iowa, technology has produced promising results. Residents there long suffered from a disgusting smell nicknamed the "Eastside Funk," which was linked to industrial meat companies. To find the culprits, the city installed a ring of monitors paired with a weather station. This system gathers real-time data to pinpoint the exact facility responsible when bad smells spread.
paragraphs.zh: 在愛荷華州第蒙（Des Moines），科技帶來了令人樂觀的成果。那裡的居民長期忍受被暱稱為「東區惡臭」的難聞氣味，這項問題與幾家工業肉品公司有關。為了找出元凶，該市安裝了一圈監測器並搭配氣象站。這個系統收集即時資料，以便在惡臭蔓延時準確指出是哪座設施釀禍。

paragraphs.en: Before installing these electronic devices, officials had to drive to neighborhoods and personally sniff the air. Although electronic noses make detection much more objective, experts note that keeping everyone happy is still difficult because human perception of smell is extremely subjective.
paragraphs.zh: 在安裝這些電子裝置之前，官員必須親自開車前往社區並用鼻子聞空氣。雖然電子鼻讓檢測變得更加客觀，但專家指出要讓每個人都滿意依然很困難，因為人類對氣味的感知極具主觀性。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 由「have/has + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，表示過去持續至今的經驗或狀態，常與表示一段時間的介系詞片語連用。
grammar.example: In Milpitas, an affluent city in California, residents have suffered from unpleasant smells for decades because of nearby industrial sites and a huge landfill.

grammar.point: 現在進行式被動語態 (Present Continuous Passive)
grammar.explain: 由「be動詞 + being + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，表達某個動作當前正被動地持續進行。
grammar.example: As cities expand through urban sprawl, homes are being built closer to smelly facilities.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 放在句首的不定詞片語用來說明主要子句動作的目的，意思是「為了……」。
grammar.example: To find the culprits, the city installed a ring of monitors paired with a weather station.

lessons.title: To train robots, AI companies are paying people in India to film themselves doing chores
lessons.title_zh: 為了訓練機器人，人工智慧公司付錢請印度人拍攝自己做家事的影片

paragraphs.en: In various parts of India, people receive payment to record themselves performing everyday household tasks. Technology developers are currently working to train artificial intelligence robots so that these machines can manage domestic chores effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度的不同地區，人們獲得報酬來記錄自己執行日常家務工作。科技開發人員目前正在努力訓練人工智慧機器人，以便這些機器能夠有效地管理家務。

paragraphs.en: A reporter from National Public Radio visited a small town in southern India named Karur earlier this month. She discovered a growing commercial sector where people make videos of themselves cleaning or cooking. For example, twenty-four-year-old Sneha Jegadish attaches a smartphone to a headset to capture her hand movements while she prepares meals.
paragraphs.zh: 國家公共廣播電台的一名記者本月初造訪了印度南部一個名為卡魯爾的小鎮。她發現了一個不斷成長的商業領域，人們在其中拍攝自己打掃或煮飯的影片。例如，二十四歲的斯妮哈·傑加迪許將智慧型手機夾在耳機上，以便在她準備餐點時捕捉她的手部動作。

paragraphs.en: Industry experts note that thousands of individuals across the country take on this job. Participants spend a few hours daily folding clothes or washing dishes, which can bring in about $120 each month. Because web data cannot teach machines physical actions, these massive video collections are necessary to supply the required information.
paragraphs.zh: 產業專家指出，全國有數千名個人從事這項工作。參與者每天花費數小時摺衣服或洗碗，這大約能帶來每個月120美元的收入。由於網路資料無法教導機器肢體動作，這些大量的影片合集對於提供所需的資訊是必要的。

paragraphs.en: Prathosh A.P., a professor at the Indian Institute of Science in Bengaluru who specializes in machine-learning systems, explains this concept. He mentions that current systems act like brains without bodies, so they need physical training to develop necessary motor skills. This demand has provided business opportunities for local firms such as Objectways.
paragraphs.zh: 班加羅爾印度科學研究所專精於機器學習系統的教授普拉托什·A·P解釋了這個概念。他提到現今的系統就像沒有身體的大腦，因此牠們需要體能訓練來發展必要的運動技能。這項需求為當地的企業（例如Objectways）提供了商機。

paragraphs.en: Inside the company buildings, employees have built mock living rooms and kitchens to record high-quality training footage. Rani N., one of the workers, records herself wiping tables and cutting vegetables in a model kitchen. Company staff believe that humanoid helpers could eventually retail in the region, bringing much-needed rest to family caregivers.
paragraphs.zh: 在公司建築內部，員工建造了模擬客廳與廚房來錄製高品質的訓練片段。其中一位員工拉妮·N在樣品廚房中錄製自己擦拭桌子和切蔬菜的過程。公司員工相信，人形幫手最終可能在該地區零售，為家庭照顧者帶來急需的休息。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 用來修飾先行詞，補充說明其詳細特徵。
grammar.example: Technology developers are currently working to train artificial intelligence robots so that these machines can manage domestic chores effectively.

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive voice)
grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: A reporter from National Public Radio visited a small town in southern India named Karur earlier this month.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 置於句中用以說明某個動作的目的或原因。
grammar.example: Inside the company buildings, employees have built mock living rooms and kitchens to record high-quality training footage.

lessons.title: This week in science: sea monsters, long COVID patients' microbiome, elephant carcasses
lessons.title_zh: 本週科學新知：海怪、長新冠患者的微生物相，以及大象屍體

paragraphs.en: In a recent science podcast episode, hosts Regina Barber and Nate Rott discussed three fascinating studies with colleague Scott Detrow. First, researchers explored the hunting speed and style of mosasaurs, which were massive ancient marine lizards that lived at the same time as T. rex. While they were not dinosaurs, these large creatures once ruled the oceans.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的一集科學podcast節目中，主持人瑞珍·巴伯（Regina Barber）與內特·羅特（Nate Rott）與同事史考特·德托（Scott Detrow）討論了三項令人著迷的研究。首先，研究人員探討了滄龍的狩獵速度與風格，這些龐大的古代海洋蜥蜴與暴龍生活在同一時期。雖然牠們不是恐龍，但這些巨大的生物曾經稱霸海洋。

paragraphs.en: A new study published in the journal Current Biology shows that certain mosasaurs could reach speeds of around 15 miles per hour using a powerful movement called a slam-start. Paleontologist Kiersten Formoso from Rutgers University explained that these animals would dramatically curl their tails and lunge forward to surprise their prey, acting as ambush predators. Researchers used physics models to reconstruct the movement of these extinct animals, marking an exciting new trend in paleontology.
paragraphs.zh: 發表在《現行生物學》（Current Biology）期刊上的一項新研究表明，某些尾巴較長的滄龍利用一種稱為強力起步的強大動作，速度可以達到大約每小時15英里。羅格斯大學（Rutgers University）的古生物學家克莉絲登·福莫索（Kiersten Formoso）解釋說，這些動物會戲劇性地捲起尾巴並向前衝刺來突襲獵物，充當伏擊掠食者。研究人員使用物理模型來重建這些滅絕動物的運動，標誌著古生物學中一個令人興奮的新趨勢。

paragraphs.en: Second, scientists in South Africa's Kruger National Park tracked dozens of elephant carcasses over several years to observe their impact on the savanna. Lead researcher Courtney Reed noted that elephant bodies initially create cold spots by flattening everything around them. However, over time, the remains transform into nutrient-rich hotspots that attract animals like impalas, showing that elephants have important ecological impacts even after death.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，南非克魯格國家公園（Kruger National Park）的科學家追蹤了數十具大象屍體多年，以觀察牠們對大草原的影響。首席研究員寇特妮·里德（Courtney Reed）指出，大象的身體最初會壓平周圍的一切來產生冷點。然而，隨著時間過去，這些遺骸會轉變成富含養分的熱點，吸引如黑斑羚等動物，這表明大象即使在死後也具有重要的生態影響。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the team discussed a study from the European Respiratory Journal focusing on the lung microbiomes of people suffering from long COVID. Respiratory physician James Chalmers from the University of Oxford explained that patients with severe symptoms six months after a viral infection had the least diverse microbiome in their respiratory tracts. Researchers emphasized that while this study shows an association rather than a direct cause, it provides a valuable direction for future investigations into long COVID.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，團隊討論了《歐洲呼吸期刊》（European Respiratory Journal）上的一項研究，該研究聚焦於罹患長新冠者的肺部微生物相。來自牛津大學（University of Oxford）的呼吸科醫師詹姆斯·查莫斯（James Chalmers）解釋說，在病毒感染六個月後症狀最嚴重的患者，其呼吸道中的微生物相多樣性最低。研究人員強調，雖然這項研究顯示的是一種關聯性而非直接原因，但它為未來調查長新冠提供了一個有價值的方向。

grammar.explain: 用關代 which 引導子句來修飾先行詞 mosasaurs。
grammar.example: First, researchers explored the hunting speed and style of mosasaurs, which were massive ancient marine lizards that lived at the same time as T. rex.

grammar.explain: 用過去分詞 published 修飾前面的一項新研究 a new study。
grammar.example: A new study published in the journal Current Biology shows that certain mosasaurs could reach speeds of around 15 miles per hour using a powerful movement called a slam-start.
grammar.focus: published in the journal Current Biology

grammar.explain: 用連接詞 that 引導名詞子句作 shows 的受詞，表達研究顯示的內容。
grammar.example: A new study published in the journal Current Biology shows that certain mosasaurs could reach speeds of around 15 miles per hour using a powerful movement called a slam-start.

lessons.title: Hit a midlife wall? Here's how to rediscover your strengths
lessons.title_zh: 面臨中年低潮？以下是重新發現你優勢的方法

paragraphs.en: As people reach midlife, many face major changes such as growing children leaving home and shifting careers. These transitions can feel difficult, but they also create chances for a fresh start. To help people navigate this stage, a new podcast titled Your Turn with Allison Aubrey has been launched to explore these life changes.
paragraphs.zh: 當人們進入中年時，許多人會面臨重大轉變，例如長大的孩子離家以及職業生涯的改變。這些轉變可能會讓人感到困難，但也為全新的開始創造了機會。為了幫助人們應對這個階段，一個名為「Your Turn with Allison Aubrey」的新廣播節目已經推出，旨在探索這些生活轉變。

paragraphs.en: A useful tool for this life reset is the VIA Character Strengths Survey, a free online questionnaire created by researchers in positive psychology. Character strengths are the positive parts of a personality that influence how individuals think, feel, and act. After people answer a series of questions, the survey ranks twenty-four different strengths, including creativity, curiosity, and bravery.
paragraphs.zh: 這個生活重新開始的一個有用工具是「VIA性格優勢問卷」，這是一份由正向心理學研究人員所建立的免費線上問卷。性格優勢是一個人格中正向的部分，會影響個人的思考、感受與行動方式。在人們回答了一系列問題之後，該問卷會將二十四種不同的優勢進行排名，其中包括創造力、好奇心與勇敢。

paragraphs.en: Research indicates that applying these strengths in everyday life could help increase well-being and lower stress. A study showed that women aged fifty and older who used a core strength in a new way experienced higher levels of happiness and less depression. The survey takes about fifteen to twenty minutes, and individuals can complete it alone or with a guide.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明，在日常生活中應用這些優勢可能有助於提升幸福感並降低壓力。一項研究顯示，五十歲及以上的女性若以新方式使用一項核心優勢，會體驗到更高的快樂程度以及較少的憂鬱。這項問卷大約需要十五到二十分鐘，個人可以獨自完成或在指導員的帶領下完成。

paragraphs.en: Experts suggest that reflecting on the results can serve as a guide for finding personal purpose. Although top strengths often reflect past experiences and how time has been spent, they are not permanent. As wellness coach Christine Carter notes, character strengths can evolve, meaning that shifting one's focus and daily activities can change the results as well.
paragraphs.zh: 專家建議，反思這些結果可以作為尋找個人目標的指南。雖然頂尖的優勢經常反映出過去的經驗以及時間是如何被花費的，但它們並不是永久的。正如健康教練克莉絲汀·卡特所指出的，性格優勢會演變，這意味著轉移一個人的焦點與日常活動也可以改變結果。

paragraphs.en: People who want to try this can take the survey and choose one strength to bring more into their daily routine. As Carter explains, individuals do not need to completely overhaul their lives, because one small step can set them on a new path.
paragraphs.zh: 想要嘗試這個方法的人可以填寫問卷，並選擇一項優勢融入他們的日常生活中。正如卡特所解釋的，個人不需要徹底改造他們的生活，因為一個小步驟就能讓他們踏上新的道路。

grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 a free online questionnaire，用以補充說明該問卷是由研究人員所建立的。
grammar.example: A useful tool for this life reset is the VIA Character Strengths Survey, a free online questionnaire created by researchers in positive psychology.
grammar.focus: created by researchers in positive psychology
