lessons.title: How an accelerating Earth led experts to adopt the leap hour
lessons.title_zh: 地球加速自轉如何促使專家採用「閏時」

paragraphs.en: For decades, scientists have worried about the way computers handle time. At a meeting in France, representatives from 69 nations voted to remove the leap second and prepare for a leap hour instead. The International Bureau of Weights and Measures decided this change to protect modern technical networks. When a minute has 61 or 59 seconds, computer software often suffers serious errors.
paragraphs.zh: 幾十年來，科學家一直擔心電腦處理時間的方式。在法國舉行的一場會議上，來自六十九個國家的代表投票決定取消「閏秒」，改為準備實施「閏時」。國際度量衡局做出這項改變是為了保護現代技術網路。當一分鐘有六十一秒或五十九秒時，電腦軟體往往會出現嚴重錯誤。

paragraphs.en: Since 1967, one second has been defined by the steady vibrations of caesium atoms. These atomic clocks provide accurate time for electricity grids, satellites, and communications. However, the rotation of the Earth is not as reliable. Because natural forces such as ocean shifts affect the planet, our world generally spins more slowly than atomic time. To solve this, officials added 27 leap seconds between 1972 and recent years.
paragraphs.zh: 自1967年以來，一秒鐘是根據銫原子穩定的振動來定義的。這些原子鐘為電網、衛星和通訊提供了精確的時間。然而，地球的自轉並沒有那麼可靠。由於海洋移動等自然力量影響著這顆星球，我們的世界自轉速度通常比原子時間慢。為了解決這個問題，官方在1972年至近年之間增加了二十七個閏秒。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the Earth has actually started to spin faster. Scientists saw a 30 percent chance that a negative leap second might be needed soon. This would mean subtracting a second from the official time. In 2012, an extra second caused computer servers to freeze, bringing down websites like Reddit and LinkedIn, and delaying Qantas flights. Experts warned that subtracting a second would carry even greater risks because software has never been tested for it.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，地球實際上開始轉得更快了。科學家發現有百分之三十的機率很快就需要一個負閏秒。這意味著要從官方時間中減去一秒。在2012年，多出的一秒導致電腦伺服器當機，使Reddit和LinkedIn等網站癱瘓，並延誤了澳洲航空的航班。專家警告，減去一秒會帶來更大的風險，因為軟體從未針對這種情況進行過測試。

paragraphs.en: Under the new plan, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) will be allowed to drift by up to an full hour before any adjustment occurs. A leap hour is not expected to happen for thousands of years. Dr Setnam Shemar, an expert from the UK's National Physical Laboratory (NPL), noted that adding an hour would resemble daylight saving time, which people already know. While some officials pointed out that this vote merely delays the issue for future generations, it successfully shields modern technology from immediate digital chaos.
paragraphs.zh: 在新計畫下，世界協調時間（UTC）將被允許在進行任何調整之前，出現最多達整整一小時的誤差。預計幾千年內都不會發生閏時。來自英國國家物理實驗室（NPL）的專家塞特南·謝馬爾博士指出，增加一小時就像人們已經熟悉的日光節約時間。儘管一些官員指出這次投票只不過是將問題延後給後代處理，但它成功保護了現代科技免於立即陷入數位混亂。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句中的「to protect」為不定詞片語，用來表示國際度量衡局做出這項決定的目的或原因。
grammar.example: The International Bureau of Weights and Measures decided this change to protect modern technical networks.

grammar.point: 現在完成被動態 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.explain: 由「has been」搭配過去分詞「defined」構成，表示從過去持續到現在已被界定的動作狀態。
grammar.example: Since 1967, one second has been defined by the steady vibrations of caesium atoms.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的「which people already know」為非限定關係子句，以關係代名詞「which」補充說明前面的「daylight saving time」。
grammar.example: Dr Setnam Shemar, an expert from the UK's National Physical Laboratory (NPL), noted that adding an hour would resemble daylight saving time, which people already know.

lessons.title: Tesla unveils what it says is a flying car
lessons.title_zh: 特斯拉揭曉其宣稱的飛天車

paragraphs.en: Tesla CEO Elon Musk recently unveiled a new sports car model during an event at a test facility in Texas. The vehicle is designed to go from 0 to 60 mph in less than a second and features unique capabilities that allow it to jump and hover using specialized air jets.
paragraphs.zh: 特斯拉（Tesla）執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）最近在德州的一處測試設施舉辦的活動中，揭曉了一款新的跑車車型。該車輛的設計能在不到一秒的時間內從靜止加速到每小時 60 英里，並具備獨特的功能，允許它透過專門的空氣噴射器進行跳躍和懸停。

paragraphs.en: During the product demonstration, the sports car performed several stunts without an actual driver inside to ensure safety. The vehicle used the built-in air jets to leap over parked company vehicles and demonstrated rapid acceleration on the test track.
paragraphs.zh: 在產品示範期間，這輛跑車在內部沒有真實駕駛的情況下執行了多項特技，以確保安全。該車輛利用內建的空氣噴射器飛躍停放的公司車輛，並在測試跑道上展示了快速加速。

paragraphs.en: Despite the successful demonstration, experts question whether a street-legal vehicle can truly fly and meet owners' expectations. Officials noted that building a hybrid between an aircraft and a ground vehicle often results in a poor-performing vehicle and a poor-performing plane.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管示範取得成功，專家們仍質疑道路合法車輛是否能真正飛行並符合車主的期望。官方指出，建造介於飛機與地面車輛之間的混合體，通常會導致性能不佳的車輛與性能不佳的飛機。

paragraphs.en: Other companies working on electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, known as eVTOLs, point out that the transition from vertical lifting to forward movement is extremely difficult. A representative from the Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum stated that what drivers might see in the future is likely limited to short hops rather than sustained flight.
paragraphs.zh: 其他致力於電動垂直起降飛行器（簡稱 eVTOL）的公司指出，從垂直升空到向前移動的轉變極為困難。來自史密森尼國家航空太空博物館（Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum）的代表表示，駕駛員未來可能看到的很可能僅限於短距離跳躍，而非持續飛行。

paragraphs.en: Musk stated that the new vehicle will go into production in 2028, although the company has often missed its previous release timelines. Whether the automobile can successfully combine high-speed ground travel with real flying capability remains to be proven.
paragraphs.zh: 馬斯克表示該新車將於 2028 年投入生產，儘管該公司過去經常錯過先前的發布時間表。這輛汽車能否成功結合高速地面行駛與真正的飛行能力，仍有待證明。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 此句使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (is designed)」構成被動語態，表達車輛是被設計成具備特定功能。
grammar.example: The vehicle is designed to go from 0 to 60 mph in less than a second and features unique capabilities that allow it to jump and hover using specialized air jets.

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial Clause)
grammar.explain: 此句使用逗號隔開的 V-ing 分詞構句 (known as eVTOLs)，用來補充說明前面的名詞。
grammar.example: Other companies working on electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, known as eVTOLs, point out that the transition from vertical lifting to forward movement is extremely difficult.

lessons.title: Chipmaker sell-off sends investors to other stocks and bonds for safety
lessons.title_zh: 晶片製造商拋售潮促使投資人轉向其他股票與債券以求避險

paragraphs.en: A worldwide drop in semiconductor chip shares pushed investors to seek safer options on Thursday, moving their funds into government bonds and different market sectors. Although computer chip stocks continued their decline for a seventh straight day, other areas provided relief. The Dow and the S&P 500 both gained ground, supported by strong performances in health care, materials, and consumer discretionary shares, while Treasury yields fell sharply as bond prices rose.
paragraphs.zh: 週四半導體晶片股的全球性下跌，促使投資人尋求更安全的選擇，將資金轉移至政府公債與不同的市場板塊。儘管電腦晶片股已連續第七天走跌，其他領域卻帶來了緩解。在醫療保健、原物料以及非必需消費品類股的強勁表現支撐下，道瓊指數與標準普爾500指數雙雙上漲，而隨著債券價格走高，公債殖利率則大幅下滑。

paragraphs.en: The turbulence started after steep losses overnight in Asian manufacturing centers. South Korea’s Kospi plunged 7.6%, which triggered a temporary trading halt after massive drops in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. In Taiwan, technology shares fell after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) CEO C.C. Wei warned that macroeconomic uncertainty and high component prices were hurting demand in certain market areas, causing TSMC shares to slide 2% despite excellent earnings.
paragraphs.zh: 這場動盪始於亞洲製造中心隔夜的沉重跌勢。南韓綜合股價指數（Kospi）暴跌7.6%，在三星電子與SK海力士大幅重挫後，觸發了暫停交易的熔斷機制。在台灣，台積電（TSMC）總裁魏哲家警告，總體經濟的不確定性以及零組件價格上漲正在打擊某些市場領域的需求，導致台積電股價儘管獲利亮眼仍下跌2%，科技股也隨之走低。

paragraphs.en: Investors are increasingly nervous about the immense costs of building artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. A strong US inflation report raised concerns that high interest rates will increase borrowing expenses for indebted tech firms. In addition, reports of slower sales growth at top AI developers like Anthropic and OpenAI, along with progress on advanced memory chips by Chinese firm CXMT, added to market anxiety.
paragraphs.zh: 投資人對於建構人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的龐大成本日益感到不安。一份強勁的美國通膨報告引發了疑慮，擔心高利率會增加負債科技公司的借貸費用。此外，有關Anthropic和OpenAI等頂尖AI開發商銷售成長放緩的報導，加上中國企業長鑫存儲（CXMT）在先進記憶體晶片上的進展，更加深了市場的焦慮。

paragraphs.en: Specialized AI cloud providers, known as neoclouds, also faced intense scrutiny. Research firm Gartner predicted that over 80% of these providers will shut down by 2030 because of high operational costs and unproven business models. Meanwhile, CoreWeave, an AI compute provider backed by Nvidia, experienced sharp price swings due to its tens of billions of dollars in debt, though Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed optimism about the firm.
paragraphs.zh: 被稱為新興雲端服務商（neoclouds）的專業AI雲端供應商也面臨嚴格檢視。研究機構顧能（Gartner）預測，由於高昂的營運成本以及缺乏獨特的商業模式，超過80%的此類供應商將在2030年前停止營運。與此同時，受到輝達（Nvidia）支持的AI運算供應商CoreWeave因其數百億美元的債務經歷了劇烈的價格波動，儘管輝達執行長黃仁勳對該公司表達了樂觀態度。

paragraphs.en: Despite the rocky week, some analysts believe fears of an AI bubble burst are exaggerated. Jefferies chief European economist Mohit Kumar pointed out that the United States is spending a larger share of its GDP on AI each year than it spent on nineteenth-century railways. He stated that he expects results to show that "earnings and demand remain robust," although political uncertainties and interest rate pressures still create market fluctuations.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管經歷了動盪的一週，一些分析師認為對於AI泡沫破裂的擔憂被過度誇大了。傑富瑞（Jefferies）首席歐洲經濟學家莫希特·庫馬爾（Mohit Kumar）指出，美國每年在AI上的支出占GDP的比例，高於十九世紀在全國興建鐵路的支出。他表示，他預期業績將證明「獲利與需求依然強勁」，儘管政治不確定性和利率壓力仍會引發市場波動。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞片語「moving...」作分詞構句，表示主要子句動作帶來的伴隨狀況或結果。
grammar.example: A worldwide drop in semiconductor chip shares pushed investors to seek safer options on Thursday, moving their funds into government bonds and different market sectors.
grammar.focus: , moving their funds into government bonds and different market sectors

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「which」前加上逗號，引導非限定關係子句，用以補充說明前述整個事件。
grammar.example: South Korea’s Kospi plunged 7.6%, which triggered a temporary trading halt after massive drops in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
grammar.focus: , which triggered a temporary trading halt after massive drops in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix

grammar.point: 介係詞片語表原因 (Prepositional Phrase of Reason)
grammar.explain: 片語介係詞「because of」後面接名詞片語，用來說明供應商停止營運的原因。
grammar.example: Research firm Gartner predicted that over 80% of these providers will shut down by 2030 because of high operational costs and unproven business models.
grammar.focus: because of high operational costs and unproven business models

lessons.title: Factory championing women workers named world’s best new building
lessons.title_zh: 致力於支持女性勞工的工廠獲選為全球最佳新建築

paragraphs.en: A seven-story textile facility in Bangladesh has won the prestigious RIBA International Prize. Organized by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA), the biennial award honors projects that demonstrate innovative thinking and community value. Green Field Factory, located in the northern city of Rangpur, was commended by the jury as a "work of quiet humility." The building successfully incorporates nature into the workplace through landscaped gardens, green verandas, and a plant-draped wall.
paragraphs.zh: 孟加拉一棟七層樓高的紡織工廠榮獲了聲譽卓著的英國皇家建築師學會國際獎（RIBA International Prize）。該兩年一度的獎項由英國皇家建築師學會（RIBA）主辦，旨在表彰展現創新思維與社群價值的建築計畫。這座座落於北部城市朗布爾（Rangpur）的「綠原工廠」（Green Field Factory），被評審團盛讚為「謙遜沉靜之作」。該建築透過景觀花園、綠意盎然的走廊以及佈滿植物的牆面，成功將大自然融入工作場所。

paragraphs.en: The local firm Nakshabid Architects designed the complex based on traditional Bengali homesteads that feature courtyards and ponds. Most importantly, the project focuses heavily on the wellbeing of its approximately 5,000 employees, who are mostly women. The factory offers special amenities, including a rooftop daycare center, an on-site medical practice, and shady areas to relax. Staff members even bring their families to enjoy these spaces outside of working hours.
paragraphs.zh: 當地的 Nakshabid Architects 建築師事務所借鑑傳統孟加拉農舍庭院與池塘的特色，設計了這座建築園區。最重要的是，這項計畫高度重視其約五千名員工的福祉，其中大多數為女性。該工廠提供了特殊的便利設施，包括屋頂日間托兒中心、廠內醫療診所以及供人放鬆的陰涼休憩區。員工甚至會在工作時間之外，帶著家人一同享受這些空間。

paragraphs.en: This environment stands in sharp contrast to past factory conditions in Bangladesh, a major textile producer. In 2013, the tragic collapse of the Rana Plaza building killed 1,100 people after workers' safety concerns were ignored. Green Field Factory prioritizes safety and challenges deep social hierarchies. For example, instead of keeping separate doorways for different ranks, all employees, managers, and owners share the exact same main entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 這種環境與身為紡織生產大國的孟加拉過去的工廠環境形成了鮮明對比。2013 年，在勞工的安全疑慮遭到忽視後，熱那大廈（Rana Plaza）不幸倒塌，導致一千一百人喪生。「綠原工廠」將安全置於首位，並挑戰了根深蒂固的社會階級制度。例如，工廠並未為不同職級保留分開的出入口，而是讓所有員工、經理與經營者共用同一個主要大門。

paragraphs.en: Operated by Karupannya Rangpur Limited, the factory manufactures textile items such as handmade rugs, doormats, and bathmats. It defeated three other shortlisted finalists, including two Belgian projects and BRAC University in Dhaka. Architect Bayejid M. Khondoker stated that he wanted to prove industry can nurture workers, showing that a factory should be a restorative space rather than a machine that drains human energy.
paragraphs.zh: 該工廠由 Karupannya Rangpur Limited 公司營運，生產手工地毯、門墊與浴室防滑墊等紡織品。它擊敗了另外三件入圍決選的計畫，包括兩件比利時作品以及位於達卡（Dhaka）的布拉克大學（BRAC University）。建築師巴耶吉德．昆多克（Bayejid M. Khondoker）表示，他想證明工業可以培育勞工，展現出工廠應該是一個讓人恢復精力的場所，而不是耗盡人體能量的機器。

vocab.zh: 享有盛譽的、聲望很高的
便利設施、生活福利設施
有助恢復元氣的、修復的

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 由過去分詞「Operated」開頭的片語修飾主詞「the factory」，省略了連接詞並表示被動語態。
grammar.example: Operated by Karupannya Rangpur Limited, the factory manufactures textile items such as handmade rugs, doormats, and bathmats.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「who」置於逗號之後，用來補充說明先行詞「employees」的相關資訊。
grammar.example: Most importantly, the project focuses heavily on the wellbeing of its approximately 5,000 employees, who are mostly women.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 「to enjoy」為不定詞片語，在句中用來表達員工帶家人前來的目的。
grammar.example: Staff members even bring their families to enjoy these spaces outside of working hours.

lessons.title: Defiance or denial? Inside Manchester City’s bubble, decked with inflatable bananas
lessons.title_zh: 反叛還是否認？曼城泡泡裡充斥著充氣香蕉

paragraphs.en: Manchester City recently played against Paris Saint-Germain at the Etihad Stadium while facing major controversy. The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism. However, the club continues to maintain its innocence and insists it is the victim of unfair treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 曼徹斯特城足球俱樂部最近在伊蒂哈德球場對陣巴黎聖日耳曼，同時面臨重大爭議。這家英格蘭超級聯賽俱樂部被判定違反了一百多項財務規定，並受到嚴厲批評。然而，該俱樂部繼續堅稱自己清白，並堅持認為自己是不公平對待的受害者。

paragraphs.en: Inside the stadium, the atmosphere felt entirely detached from the external trouble. Manager Enzo Maresca and the players have publicly stayed united behind the club ownership. Supporters also embraced their new reputation as villains, filling the stands with optimism and hundreds of yellow inflatable bananas as a historical callback to the 1980s.
paragraphs.zh: 在球場內，這種氣氛讓人感覺完全脫離了外部的麻煩。總教練恩佐·馬雷斯卡和球員們公開團結在俱樂部所有權背後。支持者也接受了他們作為反派的新形象，用樂觀情緒和數百個黃色充氣香蕉填滿了看台，作為對1980年代歷史的回顧。

paragraphs.en: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties. Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity. Despite a four to two defeat, the club and its fans maintained a cheerful appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 比賽期間，巴黎聖日耳曼得到了他們的總教練路易斯·恩rique的支持，他表達了希望曼徹斯特城能避免嚴厲處罰的願望。同時，前總教練佩普·瓜迪奧拉重返球場，對團結表現出強烈支持。儘管以四比二落敗，該俱樂部及其球迷仍保持著歡快的表象。

paragraphs.en: Once people step outside the stadium, reality quickly returns. Fans mostly refuse to discuss the legal charges and simply tell reporters to wait for the appeal. Experts note that as long as the appeal process continues, the club will continue to face serious tests during every upcoming league match.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦人們走出球場，現實很快就會回歸。球迷大多拒絕討論法律指控，只是告訴記者等待上訴。專家指出，只要上訴程序繼續進行，該俱樂部將在每一場即將到來的聯賽中繼續面臨嚴峻考驗。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 此句使用被動語態「has been found」來表達俱樂部被判定違規的事實，強調受動者。
grammar.example: The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 此句使用關係代名詞「who」引導形容詞子句，用來修飾巴黎聖日耳曼的總教練路易斯·恩rique。
grammar.example: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties.
grammar.focus: who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此句使用不定詞片語「to show strong support for unity」來表達前總教練重返球場的目的。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity.
grammar.focus: to show strong support for unity

lessons.title: OpenAI accuses former employee of leaking intel on AI device to Apple
lessons.title_zh: OpenAI指控前員工洩漏AI設備機密給蘋果

paragraphs.en: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple. According to a court document filed on Wednesday, the individual worked briefly for OpenAI for six months after leaving Apple, and then returned to Apple.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧公司OpenAI指控一名未具名的前員工，竊取有關一款尚未發布之裝置的敏感智慧財產權，並將部分細節分享給蘋果（Apple）。根據週三提交的一份法院文件，該名個人在離開蘋果後，曾在OpenAI短暫工作了六個月，隨後又返回蘋果任職。

paragraphs.en: The filing states that the worker downloaded over one hundred highly confidential files to personal storage before going back to Apple. These transferred documents allegedly included detailed pictures of the upcoming hardware along with secret engineering and manufacturing information. The final download reportedly happened in June on the worker's last day at the company.
paragraphs.zh: 該文件指出，該名員工在返回蘋果之前，將一百多份高度機密檔案下載到個人儲存空間中。據稱這些被轉移的文件包含了即將推出的硬體之詳細圖片，以及機密的工程與製造資訊。據報導，最後一次下載發生在六月份該員工在該公司的最後一天。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI further claimed that this former employee made a presentation regarding product plans to senior leaders at Apple, including an Asian operations vice president. The filing suggests that Apple is now using this gathered knowledge to push forward into the market for smart products powered by artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI進一步聲稱，這名前員工曾向蘋果的高階主管們（包含一位亞洲營運副總裁）進行有關產品計畫的簡報。該文件暗示，蘋果現在正利用這些收集到的知識，大力推動進入由人工智慧驅動的智慧產品市場。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Apple told CNN that it found no evidence supporting these claims and follows strict rules to prevent new hires from using past confidential materials. Apple also mentioned it would cooperate with OpenAI to remove any found information from its systems. Furthermore, Apple stated that the accusations are simply an attempt to create a distraction from an ongoing legal case brought by Apple in July.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，蘋果告訴美國有線電視新聞網（CNN），他們未發現任何證據來支持這些指控，並且遵守嚴格的規定以防止新進員工使用過去的機密資料。蘋果也提到，將會與OpenAI合作，從其系統中移除任何被發現的資訊。此外，蘋果表示這些指控純粹是試圖轉移焦點，以掩飾蘋果在七月所提起的一起進行中的法律訴訟。

paragraphs.en: In that previous lawsuit, Apple claimed that former staff members who moved to OpenAI downloaded confidential files and encouraged candidates to bring parts to job interviews. OpenAI denied those earlier claims, stating that Apple failed to identify any stolen trade secrets and tried to have the case dismissed. Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.
paragraphs.zh: 在該起先前的訴訟中，蘋果聲稱跳槽至OpenAI的前員工下載了機密檔案，並鼓勵應徵者將零件帶到工作面試中。OpenAI否認了那些早期的指控，表示蘋果未能識別出任何被竊取的營業秘密，並試圖駁回此案。兩大科技巨頭目前正激烈競合作開發新的智慧裝置，同時矽谷也持續看到工程師在公司之間流動的高比率。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 用來表示過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或持續的狀態。
grammar.example: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple.

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用 V-ing 修飾前面的名詞，表達主動或進行的概念。
grammar.example: Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.
